# Spatial control callback0 seam amendment

This amendment supersedes every broader synthetic-runner claim for implementer
delivery. Its accepted scope is callback0 only: generation1, NORMAL phase,
1536 actual samples, thirteen stage receipt summaries, and identity-only
installed48, matrix, target, marker and writer-set boundaries.

The package contains no installed48, matrix, target, source, cold-state or
callback-state preimage. It supports structural and identity validation only.
It does not support independent numerical replay.

## Fixed seam behavior

production_allowed=false, commit_count=0 and state_delta=null. F04 is the
unique receiver/QMF owner. The parent validation seam never mutates F04 state.

Failures after selector, U04, outer assignment and target proposal produce no
SpatialControlReceipt and no SpatialAudioProposal. Parent committed identity
and the F04 before token remain unchanged. Fault triggers are test-harness
controls and are not production parameters.

## Claims removed from acceptance

Seven callbacks and ninety-one stage receipts are
UNVERIFIED_NOT_DELIVERED. Cold preimage and source preimage are NOT_DELIVERED.
They are not part of this package's acceptance criteria. Existing hashes for
callback0 before/after state are fixture identities only because their
canonical preimages are absent.

Real ADM execution, production SpatialControlReceipt and global
CallbackTransaction remain BLOCKED or NOT_RUN.

## Dependency graph result

No new earlier production slice is closed. The first blocking contract remains
the production spatial-control parent receipt for one real cold callback.

The next required contract is exactly:

raw ADM/control identity + authoritative parent before-state bytes
-> installed48/selector/U04/outer/matrix/destination/target full material
-> authoritative parent after-state bytes and one commit proposal,

all at the same callback generation, with F04 receiver/QMF ownership unchanged.
Until that contract executes, downstream spatial audio, JOC, codec and output
production roots cannot advance.
